title: Yellow Cheesy Brazilian Seafood Fried Rice
description: A sweet and cheesy Brazilian dish featuring seafood and Christmas pudding, this pescatarian-friendly fried rice is a unique and delicious meal option. It combines the flavors of Brazil with the comfort of cheesy fried rice.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp and scallops and cook until the seafood is pink and cooked through.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the seafood and onion mixture.
Add the crumbled Christmas pudding and stir to combine.
Add the shredded cheese and stir until the cheese is melted and the mixture is well combined.
Serve the Yellow Cheesy Brazilian Seafood Fried Rice hot and enjoy.
